name: Firecrawl
shortDescription: Turns websites into markdown for LLMs. Open-source repo plus a cloud API with a free plan.
longDescription: Firecrawl crawls pages into markdown for language models. We checked the site, pricing, docs, and the GitHub release. The pricing crawl mentioned a free or hobby plan and a $0 sample, with paid tiers above that. We did not run a local install.
pricingNotes: OSS repo exists; cloud has paid tiers (samples $16/$75 etc.).
bestFor: Turning pages into clean text for retrieval
Teams that want either a cloud API or an open-source repo
notIdealFor: Interactive browser tasks such as clicking and login flows
A general web-search API — that is a different job
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
